title: FlipOrFlow
tagline: Trading and Gamified Collectibles, with Verifiable Randomness onchain
description:
Using native randomness from Flow Cadence, we have enabled gamification of popular collectibles in the Flow ecosystem. Providing Battles and WinBoxes, where the randomness is verifiable onchain.
You can play against other users with the Battles, which is a game using the NBA Top Shots collection and allows people to draw a card against and opponent, where winner takes all cards.
The other game is a WinBox where the smart contract contains numerous NFTs with different traits and attributes. 
A user can potentially win big, but ultimately always walks away with an NFT.
how_its_made:
NextJs app.
We use Wagmi, Privy as our wallet Provider.
We have built two custom smart contracts that make the game permissionlessly playable deployed on Flow using Cadence Randomness. 
We use Opensea Api to fetch onchain data of the value of the NFT collection.
We have an admin panel to allow for easy deployment of contracts and configurations.
